abstract: An illegal online-lender (pinjol ilegal) offers instant cash, then demands excessive repayment and, via debt collectors, threatens and harasses the borrower and their contacts to force payment.
safe_verification_channel: check the lender on OJK's licensed list; report illegal pinjol to Satgas PASTI

abstract: Posing as an OJK auditor, a scammer offers a paid 'service' to erase the victim's online-loan debt or recover losses, collecting a fee and personal/banking data from already-distressed borrowers.
safe_verification_channel: OJK never offers debt-erasure services or charges fees; verify via OJK's official channel 157

abstract: An unlicensed investment scheme (investasi bodong) promises high fixed returns and pressures the victim to deposit via transfer into a scheme that later collapses.
safe_verification_channel: verify any investment licence on OJK's register before paying
